title: Advanced World War: Sennen Teikoku no Koubou: Last of the Millennium
native_title: アドバンスド・ワールド・ウォー ～千年帝国の興亡～
overview: Advanced World War is a turn-based war strategy game set during World War II. The campaign mode casts the player as a commander in the German Nazi army, participating in major battles of the real-life war. There is also a free battle mode for up to four players with 10 different map scenarios to choose from. While gameplay is a turn-based affair in the style of Daisenryaku, in addition to the hex-based ground map each mission also includes a square-based aerial map overlaid on top, allowing for combat interaction between ground and air units.
